notes:
A fix for two-tablet setups.

**Links placed on the second tablet no longer vanish.** With panel wake on, a link placed on the second tablet could disappear a moment later, along with its menu, especially just after switching pieces. Panel wake was tapping the screen more often than it needed to, and one of those taps closed the link's menu. It now taps only when a new page actually arrives, which is the only time it is needed.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
